first.rationale: Verify the strongest direct precedent for the current onboarding decline and the competing pricing response, since both could materially affect sustainable qualified revenue. I currently favor a guarded onboarding simplification test because completion and activation are both deteriorating, while monitoring qualified conversion and revenue quality to avoid merely increasing low-value signups.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded onboarding simplification experiment. The verified source shows shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines in completion and activation while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it increased qualified revenue short term, the 30-day retention decline indicates poor renewal sustainability. Measure activation, completion, time-to-value, qualified conversion, 30-day retention, and downstream renewal quality before rollout.
